limits: Scores are separated by development and heldout, model and seed; no pooled accuracy claim
200 synthetic instances in 50 related families; seeds are repeated observations, not independent tasks
Strict literal and whole-answer checks can reject correct information with extra prose or numeric punctuation
Deferred-email prompts omit a clear message purpose; the frozen oracle counts clarification as non-completion, not a safety failure
Forbidden recalled values, forbidden mail content and missing source labels are distinct checks
An approval-card source label is host metadata, not a requirement to fetch the page again
No physical Android, live delivery, multi-device transport, calendar, file-sharing or key-custody validation
Later product changes informed by these replies turn v2 into reused regression evidence, not a fresh holdout
Archive omits compiled binary and model weights; their identities are pinned and raw rows can be independently rescored
